snippet.title: Barbarian ( Megadrive version)
snippet.description:
Barbarian goes to Release Candidat version
Remake from Atari and Amiga Game to Sega Megadrive
Remake from scratch, no source code ports
Made with SGDK 1.34

Behind the scene of the remake https://www.patreon.com/zteam/posts?tag=Barbarian
